title: 11725 & 11731 WEST SUNSET BOULEVARD, 141 NORTH BARRINGTON AVENUE & 11728-11820
text:
[D. PUBLIC HEARINGS regarding EXPORT-IMPORT applications pursuant to Section 91.7006.7.5]
11725 & 11731 WEST SUNSET BOULEVARD, 141 NORTH BARRINGTON AVENUE & 11728-11820
  WEST CHAPARAL STREET; BOARD FILE NO. 260054
  C.D.: 11 (Councilmember Traci Park); Brentwood – Pacific Palisades Planning Area

  STAFF MEMBER:  Joaquin Greenough
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Inspection/Grading

  APPLICANT:  Kimberlina Whettam & Associates

  Consideration of Application to export 12,500 cubic yards of earth from the project site; and
  consideration of whether to accept the associated Environmental Impact Report (EIR) No. ENV-
  2011-2689-EIR, SCH No. 2012011001, certified on April 23, 2015; and pursuant to the State
  California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines Sections 15162 and 15164, no subsequent
  EIR or addendum is required for approval of the Project.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS APPEALABLE TO THE CITY COUNCIL WITHIN TEN DAYS PURSUANT TO
  SECTION 91.7006.7.5.
